verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a cloud database platform, so the axis applies. The pack never documents an assistant inside Turso's dashboard, CLI, or shell. The official MCP integration lets external MCP-capable agents manage the account and run SQL, but that is an outside-agent hookup, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
